description.en: The agent account name (agent logon name).

description.en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID.

description.en: The holdConnId from the WebSocket after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for double-step transfer.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can find the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console.

description.zh: true:单步转，false:双步转，默认单步转
description.en:
Specifies whether to use single-step transfer. Valid values:
- true: Single-step transfer.
- false: Double-step transfer.
Default value: true.
